item.title: Crackme drill — 2026-11-02
item.description:
# Crackme: find the input (Windows x64, arg in ecx)
``` lea eax, [rcx+rcx*4] neg eax add eax, 100 cmp eax, -50 sete al movzx eax, al ret ```
Which value of `ecx` makes the function return 1? Give it in decimal.
---
**Answer:** `30` (0x1E)
1. `lea eax,[rcx+rcx*4]` computes `ecx*5` with no flags touched; `neg` then gives `-5*ecx` (two's complement: invert and add 1). 2. The check needs `-5*ecx + 100 == -50`, so `-5*ecx = -150`. 3. Dividing by -5 gives `ecx = 30`. Check: 150, negated -150, plus 100 is -50. The solution is unique modulo 2^32, because 5 is odd and so invertible.
